wiki.title: Adrienne White
wiki.extract: Adrienne Annice White Carden (born 1980/1981) is an American certified public accountant and politician who is a member of the Georgia State Senate for District 7. She won a special election in June 2026 to replace Nabilah Parkes, who resigned to focus on running for lieutenant governor, and committed to not run for a full term in the general election to be held in November 2026. She is the wife of Gwinnett County commissioner Kirkland Carden.
